models.name: Real-ESRGAN
models.description: A practical algorithm for general image restoration, particularly excelling at upscaling and enhancing textures. It serves as the core engine for many open-source upscaling interfaces due to its speed and FP16 GPU support.
models.descriptionShort: Fast, general-purpose image upscaling and texture enhancement.
models.bestFor: Family photos, phone shots, product and scanned images that need 2x-4x more pixels. A safe default when you want good detail quickly, and the best upscaler to pick on a machine without a GPU.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Increases image resolution up to 4x while reconstructing sharp edges and realistic textures.

models.name: CodeFormer
models.description: A robust face restoration algorithm for old photos and AI-generated faces. It uses a codebook-based approach to reconstruct heavily degraded, blurred, or pixelated faces with high fidelity.
models.descriptionShort: Advanced face restoration for restoring heavily degraded or blurred facial details.
models.bestFor: Old or low-resolution portraits, AI-generated faces and any photo where a face is badly blurred, pixelated or over-compressed. Usually run together with the Upscale filter so the whole frame gains detail, not just the face.

features.name: Face Recovery
features.description: Identifies and reconstructs facial features from severe degradation, pixelation, or heavy noise.

models.name: NAFNet-SIDD
models.description: NAFNet trained on the SIDD dataset to remove sensor noise from images while preserving fine details.
models.descriptionShort: Denoises images while preserving fine details.
models.bestFor: Indoor and high-ISO photos where sensor noise is strong and even. Preserves fine texture that a heavier denoiser would smear away; for motion blur use NAFNet-GoPro.

features.name: Denoise
features.description: Removes sensor noise while preserving edges and fine image details.

models.name: NAFNet-REDS
models.description: NAFNet trained on the REDS dataset for general video restoration, including blur and complex video artifacts.
models.descriptionShort: General video restoration for blur and complex artifacts.
models.bestFor: Frames from compressed or soft video where blur and mixed artifacts appear together. A general-purpose video restoration checkpoint that also works on single stills.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Restores video affected by general blur and complex visual artifacts.

features.name: Denoise
features.description: NAFNet trained on REDS for video denoising and restoration.

models.name: NAFNet-GoPro
models.description: NAFNet trained on the GoPro dataset to remove motion blur caused by camera shake and fast movement.
models.descriptionShort: Deblurs images affected by camera shake and fast motion.
models.bestFor: Photos and video frames blurred by camera shake or fast movement. Trained on motion blur, so it does little for out-of-focus shots - use Restormer there.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Removes motion blur caused by camera shake and fast movement.

features.name: Denoise
features.description: NAFNet trained on GoPro, also effective at suppressing sensor noise.

models.name: SCUNet
models.description: A practical image denoising model combining Swin Transformer and UNet architectures. It effectively removes high-ISO camera grain and severe JPEG compression artifacts without destroying fine edges or textures.
models.descriptionShort: Removes camera grain and JPEG artifacts while preserving edges.
models.bestFor: Noisy photos with high-ISO grain and images carrying heavy JPEG compression artifacts. A good all-rounder on real-world noise that still keeps edges intact.

features.name: Denoise
features.description: Cleans up high-ISO noise, color speckles, and heavy JPEG compression artifacts.

models.name: RIFE
models.description: Real-Time Intermediate Flow Estimation for video frame interpolation. An incredibly fast and lightweight model used to generate smooth slow-motion or convert low-framerate videos (e.g., 24fps to 60fps) by predicting and inserting intermediate frames.
models.descriptionShort: Fast video frame interpolation and smooth slow-motion generation.
models.bestFor: Turning 24 or 30 fps footage into 60 fps, or slowing a clip down smoothly. Fast enough for long clips; FILM copes better when there is a lot of movement between frames.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates artificial intermediate frames to increase video framerates.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Produces extremely smooth slow-motion playback from standard framerate video.

models.name: RIFE v4.26 (PyTorch)
models.description: Practical-RIFE v4.26 checkpoint archive hosted on Hugging Face. The archive contains model assets and requires the compatible Practical-RIFE runtime.
models.descriptionShort: RIFE v4.26 PyTorch model archive for video frame interpolation.
models.bestFor: Smooth slow motion and frame-rate conversion with the v4.26 weights. An alternative checkpoint for the same job as RIFE, for setups that match Practical-RIFE v4.26 exactly.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates intermediate video frames to increase frame rate.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates smoother slow-motion video by interpolating between frames.

models.name: RIFE 4.25 (MLX)
models.description: Apple Silicon MLX conversion of the RIFE 4.25 frame-interpolation model. It requires the MLX RIFE runtime and is not a PyTorch checkpoint.
models.descriptionShort: Apple Silicon MLX weights for RIFE 4.25 frame interpolation.
models.bestFor: Frame interpolation on Apple Silicon with the MLX runtime, for slow motion and higher frame rates. Only useful in an MLX-based pipeline - the app's PyTorch loaders cannot read these weights.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates intermediate video frames using the MLX runtime on Apple Silicon.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates smoother slow-motion video by interpolating between frames.

models.name: WMS-RIFE v3 (PyTorch)
models.description: RIFE v3 fine-tuned for high-resolution weather and satellite imagery sequences. The checkpoint is specialized for that domain and requires the repository's PyTorch inference code.
models.descriptionShort: Domain-specific RIFE v3 checkpoint for weather and satellite video.
models.bestFor: Interpolating weather and satellite image sequences, where motion is smooth but the frames are far apart in time. A domain-specific checkpoint - use RIFE or FILM for ordinary footage.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Interpolates frames in weather and satellite imagery sequences.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates smoother slow-motion video for supported satellite and weather footage.

models.name: RIFE (PyTorch Safetensors)
models.description: RIFE v4 PyTorch checkpoint in safetensors format, hosted with a compatible model definition. It requires the repository's PyTorch inference code.
models.descriptionShort: RIFE v4 weights in PyTorch-compatible safetensors format.
models.bestFor: Slow motion and frame-rate conversion in a PyTorch setup that prefers safetensors weights. Same job as the other RIFE entries.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates intermediate video frames between two input frames.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates smoother slow-motion video by interpolating between frames.

models.name: RIFE v4.9 (ONNX)
models.description: ONNX export of RIFE v4.9 for video frame interpolation. It requires an ONNX Runtime integration and is not a PyTorch checkpoint.
models.descriptionShort: RIFE v4.9 ONNX model for video frame interpolation.
models.bestFor: Frame interpolation through an ONNX Runtime deployment rather than PyTorch, for moving the effect into another toolchain. The app's own pipelines expect PyTorch weights.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates intermediate video frames with the ONNX Runtime.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates smoother slow-motion video by interpolating between frames.

models.name: FILM
models.description: Frame Interpolation for Large Motion by Google Research. Designed specifically to handle challenging scenes with large movement between frames, offering robust frame recovery and interpolation where faster models might fail.
models.descriptionShort: High-quality frame interpolation optimized for handling large motion and gaps.
models.bestFor: Interpolating across a lot of movement - sports, fast pans - or bridging frames so far apart that faster models guess wrong. Slower than RIFE but far steadier on large motion.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Interpolates missing frames between images with significant motion differences.

features.name: Frame Recovery
features.description: Capable of reconstructing heavily stuttering or dropped frames in a sequence.

models.name: Farnebäck Optical Flow
models.description: A classic dense optical flow algorithm developed by Gunnar Farnebäck based on polynomial expansion. Pure mathematical vector field estimation with zero VRAM requirement and no neural network weights.
models.descriptionShort: Dense polynomial optical flow for mathematical frame interpolation.
models.bestFor: Dense motion estimation and interpolation on the CPU with no downloads or GPU. A good first choice for gentle, predictable movement; the deep-flow models handle larger displacements better.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Synthesizes intermediate motion frames by computing dense polynomial optical flow displacement vectors.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Generates slow-motion playback through mathematical vector field interpolation.

models.name: DIS Optical Flow
models.description: Dense Inverse Search (DIS) optical flow algorithm (Kroeger et al.). An extremely fast variational mathematical flow estimator that runs in real-time on CPU, computing dense motion fields without deep learning.
models.descriptionShort: Ultra-fast variational mathematical optical flow for real-time motion interpolation.
models.bestFor: Real-time interpolation and motion estimation on modest hardware, including long clips, because it is the fastest classical flow method here. Pick it over Farnebäck when speed matters more than smoothness.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Computes high-speed inverse search displacement fields to synthesize intermediate frames.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Produces fluid slow motion via multi-scale inverse search motion vectors.

models.name: Dual TV-L1 Optical Flow
models.description: Total Variation L1 (Dual TV-L1) mathematical optical flow formulated by Zach, Pock, and Bischof. Minimizes an energy functional combining total variation regularization with L1 data fidelity, excelling at motion boundaries and illumination shifts with 0 VRAM.
models.descriptionShort: High-precision total-variation mathematical optical flow preserving sharp motion boundaries.
models.bestFor: Interpolation where fast movement creates sharp motion boundaries, or where brightness changes between frames (flicker, exposure shifts). Needs the OpenCV contrib extra.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Interpolates video frames using energy-minimization total variation motion fields.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates slow-motion sequences by computing discontinuity-preserving optical flow.

models.name: Lucas-Kanade (Pyramidal LK)
models.description: The classical differential optical flow method developed by Bruce Lucas and Takeo Kanade with multi-scale Gaussian pyramids. Solves the optical flow equations via spatial intensity gradients with zero neural network dependencies.
models.descriptionShort: Classical pyramidal differential optical flow for motion estimation and interpolation.
models.bestFor: Classical motion estimation for gentle, small movements, and as a reference point when comparing flow methods. The pyramid makes it more tolerant than plain Lucas-Kanade, but large motion gets smoothed away.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Interpolates frames using multi-scale pyramidal differential motion vector fields.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Synthesizes smooth slow-motion frames via gradient-based optical flow.

models.name: RAFT Optical Flow
models.description: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms (RAFT) - a deep learning optical flow model that iteratively refines flow estimates. High accuracy for complex motion but requires GPU.
models.descriptionShort: Deep learning recurrent optical flow for high-accuracy motion estimation.
models.bestFor: Accurate motion estimation in hard cases - occlusions, complex movement - when a GPU is available. The reference deep-flow model: heavier than SPyNet, clearly more accurate.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates intermediate frames using recurrent all-pairs field transforms.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates smooth slow-motion via iterative flow refinement.

models.name: FlowFormer Optical Flow
models.description: FlowFormer - Transformer-based optical flow with global attention. State-of-the-art accuracy for challenging motion sequences.
models.descriptionShort: Transformer-based optical flow with global attention for complex motion.
models.bestFor: The most accurate motion estimation on difficult sequences, when quality matters more than speed and a GPU is available.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: High-accuracy frame interpolation using transformer-based optical flow.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Premium slow-motion generation with attention-based flow estimation.

models.name: GMA Optical Flow
models.description: Global Motion Aggregation (GMA) optical flow - combines local and global motion reasoning for robust flow estimation in challenging scenarios.
models.descriptionShort: Global motion aggregation for robust optical flow in complex scenes.
models.bestFor: Scenes with occlusions and separately moving subjects, where foreground and background motion differ. Combines local and global motion reasoning for a steadier flow field.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Interpolates frames using global-local motion aggregation.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Smooth slow-motion with global motion reasoning.

models.name: SPyNet Optical Flow
models.description: Spatial Pyramid Network (SPyNet) - a lightweight deep learning optical flow model that runs efficiently on CPU and GPU. Good balance of speed and accuracy.
models.descriptionShort: Lightweight spatial pyramid network for efficient optical flow.
models.bestFor: Motion estimation on CPU or a weak GPU - the lightest deep-flow option, and a speed and accuracy middle ground between DIS and RAFT.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Efficient frame interpolation using spatial pyramid flow estimation.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Real-time slow-motion with pyramid-based flow.

models.name: RealBasicVSR
models.description: A powerful multi-frame video enhancement model. It simultaneously handles heavy shadow noise, compression artifacts, and temporal flicker common in poorly shot LOG footage, reconstructing clean high-frequency details across frames.
models.descriptionShort: Multi-frame video restoration for cleaning noisy, low-light, or degraded LOG footage.
models.bestFor: Noisy, low-light or heavily compressed video - including poorly shot LOG footage - where artifacts and flicker have to be fixed across frames rather than frame by frame. Reference entry: no video-restoration runtime is integrated in this build.

features.name: Multipurpose Restoration
features.description: Simultaneously cleans heavy compression, denoises, and sharpens moving video.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Increases video resolution using temporal data from multiple frames.

features.name: Log Restoration
features.description: Cleans up severe shadow noise, exposure flaws, and temporal artifacts unique to flat LOG video profiles.

models.name: Real-CUGAN
models.description: Real Cascade U-Nets for Anime Image Super Resolution. A highly optimized multipurpose model specifically trained for 2D illustrations and anime. It excels at instantly removing JPEG artifacts, denoising, and upscaling in a single pass.
models.descriptionShort: Multipurpose 2D/anime image upscaling, denoising, and artifact removal.
models.bestFor: Anime, manga and 2D artwork: upscaling, denoising and JPEG-artifact removal in one pass, with flat colours and hard outlines kept clean. Also good for screenshots and UI captures.

features.name: Multipurpose Pipeline
features.description: Combines artifact removal, line-art smoothing, and noise reduction in one go.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Optimized to upscale flat colors and line art without introducing blur.

models.name: NLUT
models.description: Neural-based 3D Lookup Table generator. It analyzes a reference image, extracts its cinematic look, and generates an Image-Adaptive 3D LUT to apply the exact color grading to your target image in real-time.
models.descriptionShort: Extracts colors from a reference image and creates a fast 3D LUT.
models.bestFor: Copying a colour grade: point it at a reference frame or photo whose look you like and apply that grade to your own footage as a 3D LUT, fast enough for clips.

features.name: Match Color
features.description: Transfers color grading, contrast, and style from a reference image to target media.

models.name: Deep Color Transfer
models.description: Uses deep learning and histogram analogies to perform photorealistic color transfer between images. It preserves semantic structures, ensuring skies match skies and skin matches skin.
models.descriptionShort: Advanced, semantically-aware color transfer for complex lighting.
models.bestFor: Re-grading toward a reference look while keeping the content sensible - skies stay skies and skin stays skin. Better than a plain histogram match when the two images differ in what they show.

features.name: Match Color
features.description: Transfers color grading, contrast, and style from a reference image to target media.

models.name: WCT2
models.description: Whitening & Coloring Transform. A small neural network that reproduces the color grade and tone of a reference image by aligning whitened/colored wavelet feature statistics. Runs on the CPU.
models.descriptionShort: Neural color matching that reproduces the reference's look.
models.bestFor: Matching a reference grade on photos and frames on the CPU, without needing a GPU. Produces a natural, softly matched result rather than an exact numeric match.

features.name: Match Color
features.description: Transfers color grading, contrast, and style from a reference image to target media.

models.name: Reinhard Transfer
models.description: A classic, non-AI mathematical approach to color transfer. It maps the color space mean and standard deviation from the source to the target instantly with zero VRAM usage.
models.descriptionShort: Instant, zero-VRAM mathematical color matching.
models.bestFor: A quick, exact statistical colour match when speed or zero VRAM matters, e.g. aligning a shot to a reference before export. Purely mathematical, so it cannot fix differences in content.

features.name: Match Color
features.description: Transfers color grading, contrast, and style from a reference image to target media.

models.name: Sapsan-VFI
models.description: Sapsan-VFI is a deep learning model for video frame interpolation. It is designed to generate intermediate frames between two input frames, enabling smooth slow-motion effects and higher frame rates.
models.descriptionShort: Deep learning model for up to 2x video frame interpolation and slow-motion generation.
models.bestFor: Frame interpolation for smooth slow motion and higher frame rates. Reference entry: no runtime is integrated in this build, so use RIFE or one of the optical-flow methods.

features.name: Frame Interpolation
features.description: Generates intermediate frames between two input frames for smooth video playback.

features.name: SloMo
features.description: Creates slow-motion effects by interpolating frames in video sequences.

models.name: BSRGAN
models.description: Blind super-resolution GAN trained with a practical degradation model (downsampling, Gaussian blur, noise, JPEG compression). Restores heavily degraded low-resolution images to sharp 4x output with an RRDB generator, including blur types that plain deblurring nets cannot reconstruct.
models.descriptionShort: Blind restoration + 4x upscaling that handles blur, noise, and JPEG artifacts.
models.bestFor: Blindly restoring images whose degradation is unknown - a mix of blur, noise and JPEG compression - while enlarging 4x in the same pass. Handy for old compressed photos; reference entry in this build.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Reconstructs sharp high-resolution detail from images degraded by blur, noise, and compression.

features.name: Multipurpose Restoration
features.description: Single-pass cleanup of combined blur, sensor noise, and JPEG compression artifacts.

models.name: GFPGAN
models.description: Practical face restoration GAN trained on FFHQ. Reconstructs facial details from heavily blurred, pixelated, or compressed face crops; the v1.4 checkpoint provides richer detail and better identity preservation.
models.descriptionShort: Face-focused restoration for blurry, noisy, or low-resolution faces.
models.bestFor: Portrait photos and video frames with small or moderately degraded faces. Fast and reliable for general face cleanup; CodeFormer is usually better on badly damaged faces.

features.name: Face Recovery
features.description: Reconstructs faces from heavy blur or pixelation, restoring sharp facial features.

models.name: RestoreFormer
models.description: Transformer-based face restoration (VQGAN encoder + multi-head attention decoder) that preserves subtle facial features and natural skin textures. Original model released with GFPGAN.
models.descriptionShort: Face restoration with a transformer decoder for fine detail preservation.
models.bestFor: Faces that need their fine structure - lashes, skin texture, hair - kept intact while being sharpened. Sits between GFPGAN's smoothness and CodeFormer's codebook look.

features.name: Face Recovery
features.description: Retains subtle facial features and landmarks with natural, transformer-based textures.

models.name: RestoreFormer++
models.description: Upgraded RestoreFormer with a large VQGAN backbone and attention reconstruction for finer skin texture and identity retention. The v1.0.0 release ships the checkpoint as a Git LFS asset on GitHub.
models.descriptionShort: VQGAN + full-attention face restoration with finer skin texture.
models.bestFor: Faces from very low-resolution or heavily compressed sources where identity and natural skin texture must survive. The heaviest and most detailed of the RestoreFormer family.

features.name: Face Recovery
features.description: VQGAN backbone with cross-attention for higher structural fidelity and skin detail.

models.name: DifFace
models.description: Diffusion-based blind face restoration (diffused error contraction). Bridges the degraded image to a pretrained diffusion prior, avoiding hallucinated features and keeping identity likeness; released as a Diffusers pipeline checkpoint.
models.descriptionShort: Diffusion face restoration focused on identity preservation.
models.bestFor: Faces where the likeness has to survive the restoration - portraits and group shots you would not want re-invented by the model. Diffusion-based, so it is slower than GFPGAN and wants a GPU.

features.name: Face Recovery
features.description: Contracts the diffused error before connecting to a pretrained diffusion prior.

models.name: Restormer
models.description: Efficient Transformer for high-resolution image restoration. This entry is the single-image defocus-deblurring checkpoint - the closest match among classical deblurring nets for out-of-focus / soft-lens blur. It reduces blur but cannot recover facial identity from severe blur.
models.descriptionShort: Transformer defocus-deblurring for out-of-focus images.
models.bestFor: Out-of-focus or soft-lens photos - missed autofocus, phone macro shots. It reduces defocus blur but cannot recover identity from severe blur; for motion blur use NAFNet-GoPro.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Removes defocus/out-of-focus blur using a transformer-based restoration net.

features.name: Focus Fix
features.description: Restores edge sharpness and fine detail in soft or out-of-focus footage.

models.name: DeblurGAN-v2
models.description: GAN-based single-image motion deblurring with an FPN backbone (Inception-ResNet-v2 / MobileNet variants). Trained on motion blur like NAFNet, so defocus or compression blur yields limited gains. Official weights (fpn_inception.h5) are hosted on Google Drive - download manually and place the file into models/.
models.descriptionShort: GAN motion deblurring (FPN backbone); weights require manual download.
models.bestFor: Motion-blurred stills, as an alternative checkpoint to NAFNet-GoPro. Trained on motion blur, so defocus or compression blur shows little improvement.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Removes motion blur caused by camera shake and fast movement.

models.name: MPRNet
models.description: Multi-stage progressive restoration CNN (CVPR 2021) with a GoPro deblurring checkpoint. Like NAFNet it focuses on motion blur; it also has denoising checkpoints. The official weights are hosted on Google Drive - download manually into models/ (model_deblurring.pth).
models.descriptionShort: Multi-stage CNN deblurring (GoPro); weights require manual download.
models.bestFor: Motion-blurred photos, with denoising checkpoints available as well. A slower alternative to NAFNet-GoPro that is sometimes cleaner on heavy blur.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Removes motion blur and restores sharp detail via progressive multi-stage CNN stages.

features.name: Denoise
features.description: Removes sensor noise while preserving edges and fine image details.

models.name: FFTformer
models.description: Frequency-domain transformer for high-quality image deblurring, trained on the GoPro dataset. Motion-blur oriented like NAFNet, so defocus/compression blur shows the same limitations.
models.descriptionShort: Frequency-domain transformer for motion deblurring.
models.bestFor: Motion-blurred photos and frames, using a frequency-domain model. Another NAFNet-GoPro alternative, with the same limits on defocus and compression blur.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Restores sharp detail from motion-blurred images using a frequency-domain transformer.

models.name: DiffBIR
models.description: Diffusion-based general blind image restoration (IRControlNet + SwinIR stage-1). Generates plausible high-frequency detail for blur, noise, and compression. Restored content is realistically hallucinated, not a pixel-perfect recovery. This entry is the single-file general_full_v1.ckpt.
models.descriptionShort: Diffusion prior for high-quality blind restoration (GPU with 12GB+ VRAM).
models.bestFor: Badly degraded photos and frames where plausibly re-invented detail is acceptable - old scans, heavy compression. Needs a GPU with roughly 12GB VRAM, and it invents detail rather than recovering it.

features.name: Multipurpose Restoration
features.description: Generates plausible detail for images degraded by heavy blur, noise, and compression.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Increases resolution while synthesizing realistic high-frequency detail.

models.name: SUPIR
models.description: Scaled-up generative prior (SDXL) for photo-realistic blind restoration and upscaling. Among the strongest restorers, but wants roughly 24GB or more of VRAM. v0Q checkpoint (~5.3GB) mirrored on Hugging Face.
models.descriptionShort: SDXL-based generative restoration for photo-realistic results (needs ~24GB VRAM).
models.bestFor: The strongest option here for photo-realistic restoration of very degraded stills, e.g. old family photos. Needs roughly 24GB of VRAM, so treat it as a high-end workstation choice.

features.name: Multipurpose Restoration
features.description: Photo-realistic restoration of blur, noise, and compression artifacts with an SDXL prior.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: High-quality upscaling with generative detail synthesis.

models.name: SeeSR
models.description: Semantics-aware (caption-guidance) diffusion super-resolution. Prior-guided restoration that tends to produce more faithful detail. Requires the SD2.1-base model in addition to the uploaded weights.
models.descriptionShort: Semantics-aware diffusion super-resolution with caption guidance.
models.bestFor: Upscaling where the result must stay faithful to the original scene - text, signs, small structures - by using caption guidance. A good pick when you would rather preserve structure than have detail invented.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Semantics-guided upscaling that synthesizes detailed textures matching image content.

models.name: StableSR
models.description: Diffusion-based real-world super-resolution with a time-aware encoder (IJCV 2024). Restores realistic detail while preserving structure. Pairs with the VQGAN codebook (vqgan_cfw_00011.ckpt) for feature encoding.
models.descriptionShort: Diffusion super-resolution with time-aware encoding for realistic detail.
models.bestFor: Photo-realistic upscaling of real-world photos while keeping the structure stable. A slower, diffusion-based alternative to Real-ESRGAN on degraded inputs.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Real-world super-resolution restoring realistic high-frequency detail via a diffusion prior.

models.name: CCSR
models.description: Controllable diffusion super-resolution with user-tunable structure/texture balance. Restores detail while keeping structure stable. Weights mirrored on Hugging Face (real-world_ccsr.ckpt).
models.descriptionShort: Controllable diffusion super-resolution with structure/texture balance.
models.bestFor: Upscaling where you want to steer how much new texture is added versus how much structure is preserved - useful for images mixing smooth areas with fine detail.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: Diffusion upscaling with adjustable structure/texture trade-off.

models.name: OSEDiff
models.description: One-step effective diffusion network for real-world super-resolution (NeurIPS 2024). Much faster than multi-step diffusion restorers while keeping diffusion-quality detail. Official weights are distributed via Google Drive - download manually.
models.descriptionShort: One-step diffusion super-resolution (fast, NeurIPS 2024); weights via manual download.
models.bestFor: Fast, one-step diffusion-quality upscaling: the diffusion option to reach for when the multi-step models are too slow to iterate with.

features.name: Upscale
features.description: One-step diffusion upscaling producing sharp, realistic detail at reduced inference cost.

models.name: TSRN-RTVD
models.description: Real-time video deblurring network (Temporal Spatial Residual Network) trained on the RTVD dataset. Uses short temporal context, so it removes camera-shake blur well on moving footage. Runs via the official tsrn-rtvd package (pip install git+https://github.com/msu-video-group/tsrn-rtvd) with a streaming reset/process_next API; this entry is the main fine-tuned checkpoint (tsrnn_bt1_exact_ft.pth).
models.descriptionShort: Real-time video deblurring (RTVD); streaming API via the tsrn-rtvd package.
models.bestFor: Deblurring moving footage in a streaming pass - shaky handheld video - where frame-by-frame deblurring would flicker. Runs through the official tsrn-rtvd package.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Removes motion and shake blur from video streams in real time using temporal context.

models.name: OpenCV NAFNet (ONNX)
models.description: NAFNet GoPro deblurring weights exported to ONNX by the OpenCV model zoo (deblurring_nafnet_2025may). Runs through OpenCV 5 / cv2.dnn with the official demo (demo.py, demo.cpp) - it is NOT loadable by the app's PyTorch sharpen pipeline. For in-app NAFNet deblurring use the NAFNet-GoPro weights from this catalog.
models.descriptionShort: NAFNet GoPro deblurring as ONNX for OpenCV / cv2.dnn.
models.bestFor: Running NAFNet deblurring outside openVideoAI, in OpenCV-based tooling (cv2.dnn, C++ or Python). For the same effect inside the app, use the NAFNet-GoPro entry.

features.name: Sharpen / Deblur
features.description: Motion deblurring with NAFNet weights exported to ONNX for the OpenCV DNN module.

models.name: Zero-DCE
models.description: Zero-Reference Deep Curve Estimation for low-light enhancement. A tiny (3MB) network that learns pixel-wise light enhancement curves without paired training data, so it lifts shadows while keeping colors natural.
models.descriptionShort: Tiny AI low-light enhancer that lifts shadows while keeping colors natural.
models.bestFor: Night shots, underexposed interiors and backlit photos where shadows need lifting without washing the colours out. Tiny and fast; use the classical low-light enhancer when nothing should be downloaded.

features.name: Low-Light Enhancement
features.description: Recovers detail in underexposed, night-time and backlit footage.

models.name: Auto Low-Light (Classical)
models.description: Classical low-light enhancement built on CLAHE, adaptive gamma correction and local contrast. Runs on any machine instantly with no download required.
models.descriptionShort: Instant classical low-light boost with no download.
models.bestFor: A quick brightness and contrast lift on dark photos and frames, with no download and no GPU. Good for a fast pass or a weak machine; Zero-DCE looks more natural on very dark material.

features.name: Low-Light Enhancement
features.description: Lifts shadows and boosts local contrast on the CPU.

modules.display_name: LOG Footage Enhancer & Neural Color Grade
modules.description: Transforms flat, underexposed, crappy, or noisy LOG footage into clear, high-dynamic-range Rec.709 video using AI-driven tone mapping, neural LUTs, and temporal denoising.

step_1.purpose: Cleans heavy chroma and luma sensor noise typical in shadows of underexposed or pushed LOG footage prior to color boosting, preserving sharp details.

step_2.purpose: Acts as an AI auto-exposure tool, dynamically adjusting the light curve to recover crushed shadows and balance blown-out highlights without requiring paired reference data.

models.name: FastLLVE
models.purpose: Applies real-time low-light video enhancement to dramatically improve color constancy and brightness while preventing inter-frame flickering.

models.name: ITMLUT
models.purpose: Projects the flat LOG gamma curve into standard Rec.709 or HDR color spaces with precision, restoring natural skin tones and saturation with minimal interpolation error.

modules.description: Regularizes the color profile of clips to fix over/underexposure, contrast issues, warmth issues, and color spill. Applies a flat, neutral color grading to bring clips to a consistent, balanced look.

step_1.purpose: Balances color channels using the Gray World assumption to neutralize warmth and color spill issues.

step_2.purpose: Flattens the tone curve to reduce over/underexposure and creates a regularized color profile.

step_3.purpose: Normalizes color saturation to create a consistent, flat color profile.
